fichas.title: Reception and emergency provision
fichas.summary: The accident and emergency unit should be quickly accessible to stretcher patients via the ambulance hall and to ambulant patients from the main entrance. It comprises small examination and treatment rooms, with additional plastering, first-aid and surgery rooms; the X-ray department should be nearby. Provide storage for stretchers and wheelchairs in the ambulance hall, and group clinical service doctors, surgeons and anaesthetists nearby.

fichas.title: Clinical medical service and specialist treatment rooms
fichas.summary: Clinical medical service comprises the management rooms of individual specialist departments or clinics. Its classic facilities include a medical superintendent’s room with office support, a senior doctor’s room, and an examination room with waiting area and toilets. Specialist provisions described include rooms for ophthalmology, ear, nose and throat, and urology. The clinical medical service rooms form the core of the hospital’s ground-floor outpatient zone.

fichas.title: Functional diagnosis and endoscopy department
fichas.summary: Functional diagnosis addresses examinations of heart, thorax and circulation functions. Examination rooms should be accessible through patient cabins and, where needed, preparation rooms. The endoscopy department includes examination and treatment rooms, patient WCs, a bedded waiting area and a rest room. The page states that the number of beds is twice the number of endoscopy rooms.
